import sys,os,json,binascii,hashlib

sys._m5_loader_nonce='3f882f25b4f047c98f0b782ec6dd3df4'
sys._m5_loader_owner=__import__('__main__')
sys._m5_loader_owner._m5_loader_count=0
_root='/flash/.main-loader-probe-3f882f25b4f047c98f0b782ec6dd3df4'
os.mkdir(_root)
_files={'v1': {'main.mpy': {'data': '', 'sha256': '78a29e9f8a28a534d4c8502da65b9b0292f70e28a720d479465762e6cc1aa3fb', 'bytes': 1171}, 'dep.mpy': {'data': 'TQYAHwQBDGRlcC5weQAPClZBTFVFAApOT05DRQAFIDNmODgyZjI1YjRmMDQ3Yzk4ZjBiNzgyZWM2ZGQzZGY0AGgABAEjkRYCIwAWA1Fj', 'sha256': 'a18339bbffe55cfe6e85e4a3ff35d17e723d4b34fede85044c3d612ff2bdf6ef', 'bytes': 78}}, 'v2': {'main.mpy': {'data': '', 'sha256': '638265504ca082e4fb6c961525118b75d47e40bd0eac97dbc4d15f42eabb3274', 'bytes': 1170}, 'dep.mpy': {'data': 'TQYAHwQBDGRlcC5weQAPClZBTFVFAApOT05DRQAFIDNmODgyZjI1YjRmMDQ3Yzk4ZjBiNzgyZWM2ZGQzZGY0AGgABAEjnRYCIwAWA1Fj', 'sha256': '4f6be3d6affcd7b862102891353895befc9665accde7c8007a712ab0ee252406', 'bytes': 78}}, 'exception': {'main.mpy': {'data': '', 'sha256': 'c5d2fb9f96b6a3c505f695866030072a37364acc1ffe0f96d2b031e56dd47e9c', 'bytes': 1168}, 'dep.mpy': {'data': 'TQYAHwQBDGRlcC5weQAPClZBTFVFAApOT05DRQAFIDNmODgyZjI1YjRmMDQ3Yzk4ZjBiNzgyZWM2ZGQzZGY0AGgABAEjkRYCIwAWA1Fj', 'sha256': 'a18339bbffe55cfe6e85e4a3ff35d17e723d4b34fede85044c3d612ff2bdf6ef', 'bytes': 78}}, 'loop': {'main.mpy': {'data': '', 'sha256': '099326272850f0966e2659e35c0a934561944b9987afc0457ccf493c33148c6c', 'bytes': 1336}, 'dep.mpy': {'data': 'TQYAHwQBDGRlcC5weQAPClZBTFVFAApOT05DRQAFIDNmODgyZjI1YjRmMDQ3Yzk4ZjBiNzgyZWM2ZGQzZGY0AGgABAEjnRYCIwAWA1Fj', 'sha256': '4f6be3d6affcd7b862102891353895befc9665accde7c8007a712ab0ee252406', 'bytes': 78}}, 'format': {'main.mpy': {'data': '', 'sha256': '07583694ee73a5bed2119ece31a80d516f843173857faf13eacc3e5bf02b6832', 'bytes': 1171}, 'dep.mpy': {'data': 'TQYAHwQBDGRlcC5weQAPClZBTFVFAApOT05DRQAFIDNmODgyZjI1YjRmMDQ3Yzk4ZjBiNzgyZWM2ZGQzZGY0AGgABAEjkRYCIwAWA1Fj', 'sha256': 'a18339bbffe55cfe6e85e4a3ff35d17e723d4b34fede85044c3d612ff2bdf6ef', 'bytes': 78}}}
_inventory={}
for _case,_members in _files.items():
 _dir=_root+'/'+_case
 os.mkdir(_dir)
 _inventory[_case]={}
 for _name,_row in _members.items():
  _raw=binascii.a2b_base64(_row['data'])
  with open(_dir+'/'+_name,'wb') as _stream:
   assert _stream.write(_raw)==len(_raw)
  with open(_dir+'/'+_name,'rb') as _stream:
   _saved=_stream.read()
  _hash=binascii.hexlify(hashlib.sha256(_saved).digest()).decode()
  assert len(_saved)==_row['bytes'] and _hash==_row['sha256'], 'guest MPY bytes changed'
  _inventory[_case][_name]={'sha256':_hash,'bytes':len(_saved)}
print('MAIN_LOADER_CAP '+json.dumps({'kind':'setup','nonce':sys._m5_loader_nonce,'owner_id':id(sys._m5_loader_owner),'mpy':getattr(sys.implementation,'_mpy',None),'cwd':os.getcwd(),'inventory':_inventory}))
